notes: Ocean Beach (piece O1). Blocks, west column then east column, top to bottom: 2001 (cut by the top), 2002 (cut by the top), 2085, 2084, 2086, 2087, 2168, 2167, 2169 (cut by the bottom), 2170 (cut by the bottom); one polygon each, corners on the outer edge of the block's thin line. West-column blocks' west sides lie on their own slanted thin line, the Lower Great Highway's east line, which is drawn only beside the blocks; from about y 2745 to 2805 (block 2086) it runs merged with the heavy zoning border and its place there is the straight continuation of the line above (about 1 px doubt). The Great Highway is drawn as five straight parallel lines, continuous through the whole box, called here A to E from the west (x of their ink at y 2700): A 580-581, B 595-596, C 603-604, D 615-617, E 640-641; the blocks' west line F at 655-656. Bands at y 2700 and what they are made: west of A (x 300-579: ocean, the wavy shoreline at about x 518, and beach) = open polygon, one with the ocean, line A inside it; A-B (x 582-594) = STREET, a roadway: the name GREAT HIGHWAY is printed in this band at y 3190-3320 (x 617-625 there), and at Lincoln Way (y about 1450) the band runs open into the Great Highway north of it; B-C (x 595-604, paper 597-602) = open polygon, a median strip: at Lincoln Way (y about 1458, x 526-534) lines B and C close it with a printed end, so it is outlined land, not road; C-D (x 605-614) = STREET, the other roadway: open at Lincoln Way like A-B, and today's centre line (an aid) falls at about x 611 here; D-E (x 615-641, paper 618-638) = open polygon, a planted strip between the Great Highway and the Lower Great Highway: closed by a printed end at Lincoln Way (y about 1453, x 548-570); E-F (x 642-654) = STREET, the Lower Great Highway, with the heavy zoning border at x 647-653 printed inside it; today's centre line (an aid) at about x 647 here. Each open polygon takes its bounding printed lines (A; B and C; D and E), as a block takes its own outline, so the street is the paper between the lines. Doubtful for the owner: whether B-C (about 28 ft) is a median or a third roadway, and whether D-E is a planted strip or a walk/road; both were read from the printed ends at Lincoln Way, not from any name. The P (x 505-575, y 2475-2510) and PACIFIC OCEAN are letters in the open polygon. The heavy zoning borders in 48th Avenue (x 698-707) and in the cross streets are street; those inside blocks 2001, 2085, 2086, 2084 are block. The strip east of the east column (x 770-775, 47th Avenue) is street.
